findings.source_quote: …at is the relationship of the kingdom to the church? The kingdom is not, as contemporary usage would almost have us think, a generic version of, or a substitute word for, the church. Rather, the kingdom has to do with the reign or rule of God. It is both a present reality, having been inaugurated in the person and mission of Jesus, and a future expectation which God will bring to completion at the end of time.
